description: 한국전자통신연구원_객체검출 API [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 이미지에서 사람, 자동차 등 일반적으로 나타나는 다양한 종류의 객체 카테고리를 분류하고 객체의 위치정보(박스 좌표)를 감지할 수 있는 기술로 활용됩니다. 영상 데이터에서 다양한 형태의 객체를 인식하는 객체 인식기를 통해 객체 인식 결과를 제공합니다. 객체 검출 (Object Detection) API는... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 이미지인식, 인공지능, 이미지분석, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
